observedDefect: The navigation pipe accepted the correct session at 12:34:42.150. Native confirmation timed out at 12:34:47.170; Codex reported that session active at 12:34:47.930 and resume success at 12:34:52.656.

Reapply the actual saved URI/group once if startup replaces the editor selection.

realCodexSmoke.scope: Opened an existing local session in a disposable VS Code profile, closed the process, then reopened and verified the saved session remains selected beyond the 30-second renderer startup timer. No prompt was sent.
realCodexSmoke.observation: The restored session reported resume success; no renderer startup timeout occurred.

limitations: The original Codex renderer_ready_timeout was not reproduced in the real-provider smoke test, which also passed before this change. This update addresses the confirmed premature timeout and adds recovery for competing startup selection; it does not modify Codex itself.
installation: Installed locally; activation waits for the active turn to finish and a VS Code window reload/reopen.

nativePipeIntegration.testHarnessFix: Explicitly focus the disposable VS Code window before probing its HWND. VS Code extension-test mode reported focused=true while native Windows still had another app in front.

activation: Detached updater queued to activate installed helper after active turns drain. Reload/reopen VS Code to activate the extension changes.
